llm_raw_reply: Amazon Pay ICICI gives you about ₹9,000 a year on your ₹15,000‑a‑month Amazon spend and has no joining or annual fee, so it’s the simplest pick. The HDFC Millennia and Swiggy Ornge cards also save roughly ₹9,000 but each charge a fee to join.
final_reply: Amazon Pay ICICI gives you about ₹9,000 a year on your ₹15,000‑a‑month Amazon spend and has no joining or annual fee, so it’s the simplest pick. The HDFC Millennia and Swiggy Ornge cards also save roughly ₹9,000 but each charge a fee to join.
